set.body:
Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: SITE01
Accountable role (person unassigned): Product owner with institutional operator and curator
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: A named deployment brief replacing planning assumptions with the selected institution's actual needs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Record hosting, identity provider and external-collaborator model, data classification, permitted source collections, retention/withdrawal obligations and support hours.
2. Name acceptance owners and record capacity, growth, availability and recovery targets, distinguishing scientific-data RPO from restrictive-policy durability.
3. Explicitly reconcile beta scope with PRD targets and original pilot gates; if DICOM/XNAT or visualization is essential, make C01/W03 a dependency of program completion. Unavailable real inputs remain open; do not invent acceptance.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
